mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_memory_tombstone WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND target_type='SOURCE' AND target_id=#{source} AND deletion_epoch>=#{epoch}

SELECT v.status,p.policy_json FROM ai_memory_version v LEFT JOIN ai_memory_policy_version p ON p.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND p.policy_id=v.policy_id AND p.version_id=v.policy_version_id WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND v.item_id=#{item} AND v.id=#{version} ORDER BY v.id

SELECT o.tenant_id,o.event_id,j.id AS job_id,o.deletion_epoch,o.revision FROM ai_memory_outbox o JOIN ai_memory_deletion_job j ON j.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND j.id=o.event_id AND j.item_id=o.aggregate_id AND j.deletion_epoch=o.deletion_epoch WHERE o.event_type IN ('MEMORY_FORGET','MEMORY_DERIVED_REVOKED','MEMORY_SOURCE_REVOKED') AND o.status IN ('QUEUED','CLAIMED','BLOCKED') AND o.attempts<8 AND (o.lease_until IS NULL OR o.lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND j.status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','BLOCKED','RETRYABLE_FAILED') AND j.attempts<8 AND j.deadline>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY j.deadline,o.tenant_id,o.event_id LIMIT #{limit}
